reviewer_role: Independent nonimplementing Astra reviewer; source, saved-raw, interpretation and actual-render review

scope.model: Restricted collisionless, non-tilted LRS Bianchi I, independent initial matter/radiation quadrupoles, fixed reviewed Einstein-kinetic source
scope.normalization: Full spatial Frobenius: S_F=sqrt(6)s/H; Sigma_F=abs(S_F); P_X=sqrt(6)K p_X/H^2; Pi_X=abs(P_X); Pi_total=abs(P_m+P_r); K=8 pi G/c^2 with p_X in J/m^3 and proper-time H in s^-1
scope.radiation_species_limit: Photons and exactly massless neutrinos share the restricted initial brightness and collisionless evolution; this does not establish independent photon/neutrino initial quadrupoles or different collision operators.
scope.comparison_to_PR198: Half-contraction/Frobenius conversion is explicit; source/state identity remains distinct. This verdict does not merge B trajectories with the separate PR198 625+606 trajectories.

execution_source_assignment.source_transition: Operational bool serialization fix and bounded deadline/identity accounting only; no physical RHS, solver tolerances, initial conditions or source cosmology change.

recovered_100_cases.metadata_rule: Unrecorded solver/process metadata remain explicitly unavailable; endpoint completeness is not represented as an observed successful original process exit.

numerical_gate_summary.B1: All 140 new nominal cases and three refinements passed the contracted data gates; 35 references have exact source/config/raw identity and no new attempts.
numerical_gate_summary.B2: All 237 full-state tails passed the saved-data gates. All original states and diagnostics through z=4 are retained exactly; the join and appended arrays, units, signed sums, packet/number/brightness samples and endpoint coverage were independently checked.
numerical_gate_summary.refinement: Three B1 and six B2 selected refinement controls pass their scoped gates. No uniform parameter-domain or truncation-error theorem is inferred.
numerical_gate_summary.positivity: Packet positivity and the contracted 64-node angular brightness samples pass; continuous angular positivity is not certified.
numerical_gate_summary.resource_scope: Cooperative locally available resources, one-thread BLAS and bounded own workers; no claim that NCP ran, no benchmark or measured speedup claim.

interpretation_admitted: For the two computed opposite-component Sigma_i=0 cases, initially cancelling signed total stress evolves into nonzero signed shear; individual component stresses remain independent.

Their largest saved absolute shear occurs at the stored z=4.371956272299825 sample; source-evaluated derivatives change sign between that sample and z=4.308095462679229. This is a sampled maximum and derivative bracket, not a fitted exact continuous extremum.
At z=2 the two absolute shears retain approximately 85.25 percent of their respective saved maxima.
At the computed Sigma_F_i=0.003 section, all 25 signed shears are positive at z=4 and four of 25 are negative at z=2. The count comes from numeric saved values, not color inference.

The matter/radiation response secants use four actual endpoint samples at signed initial amplitude plus/minus 0.0003; they are descriptive finite-grid quantities rather than universal linear-response coefficients.

figure_review.method: Inspected actual generated PNGs, including repaired baseline/history print pages and the final shared-colorbar signed-shear joint figure; reviewed source/data provenance and final plot manifest. Root independently inspected the four main figures.
figure_review.bundle_scope: The final hash-bound plot source and manifest identify the seven fixed-Sigma detail pages, navigation overview, histories, baseline/controls, selected signed-shear joint panel, PDF companions and CSV plot data.
specific_findings: No remaining clipping or label overlap in the inspected final main renderings.
Signed quantities and nonnegative norms are explicit; SI normalization is shown.
Mean-redshift endpoints and exact z=4 join are explicit.
Discrete nonuniform initial axes are categorical and are not presented as interpolated surfaces.
The joint z=4/z=2 panels share color scales by quantity; near-zero signs are supported numerically.
Opposite-component history pages share symmetric shear limits.
figure_review.print_scope: The 7.2-inch detail/print pages are reviewed as approximately 183-mm double-column preliminary figures. The 28-panel overview is for navigation; 90-mm single-column typography is not certified.
figure_review.cache_scope: Bounded 512-entry per-render cache stores only verified immutable case/epoch data; no persistent cache, no scientific change, no measured speedup claim.
figure_review.manifest_snapshot_note: Any earlier generation-time PENDING_REVIEW field is a historical snapshot. This separate final receipt supplies the subsequent scientific and actual-figure decision.
